confirmedFindings.title: Missing Private IP Filter in Webhook Dispatcher
confirmedFindings.body: The destination URL validator removes hostname and private IP validation, allowing tenants to configure internal network destinations (e.g. AWS metadata endpoint 169.254.169.254, internal microservices) and triggering Server-Side Request Forgery.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Enforce strict hostname resolution and deny private RFC 1918 addresses, loopback, and cloud metadata IPs.
